about: Grammar corrections Amal made that fit no existing rule. Each is a proposed new rule for Medi's yes or no; nothing here is scored until he says yes. Built by scripts/full_audit_build.py from the audit rows and data/lesson-work/full-audit/proposed-buckets.json.

proposals.name: pronoun matches who you mean
proposals.proposed_rule: Pick the pronoun for the real person: humma for 'they' (his family), heyye for 'she' (his fiancee), not the last pronoun used.

proposals.name: noun, not verb, after a preposition
proposals.proposed_rule: After bi / fi / min use the noun of the action, not a verb: ana ma3roof bi el-tabe5 (her chat 09-21), not bi a6bo5.

proposals.proposed_rule: After ayy (which / any) the noun is singular, like after kam: ayy kilme, not ayy kalimaat.

moments.medi_said: If, أي كلمات، مشكلة، مشكل-- yeah. عندي
moments.amal_said: مشكلة، أي كلمة؟
moments.why: He said أي كلمات (any words) at 06:59 (speaker label is '?', but it continues his 'If,' at 06:56 and his 'مشكلة' at 07:03); Amal recast أي كلمة at 07:08 and he repeated أي كلمة at 07:12. No bucket covers ayy + singular (E5 is kam only), so PROPOSE per GR-18. Low because her line may also be a plain question ('which word?') prompting him to name it.

proposals.proposed_rule: 'X are easy to do' is said impersonally: el-asmaa2 sehel netzakkarhom - the adjective stays sehel (masc. singular, it does not agree with the plural noun) and the verb carries the object 'them'.

moments.medi_said: أسماء، سـ- uh, سهلي-- سهلات.
moments.amal_said: So how we will say it؟ It's different than English. We will say the nouns it's easy to remember them. So it's easy. We don't need to tie it back to أسماء. ... So just سهل to remember them.
moments.why: He made the adjective plural (sahlaat) to agree with أسماء; Amal explained it is just سهل plus 'to remember them' (chat sehel netzakkarhom); no bucket covers the impersonal 'easy to' pattern.

proposals.proposed_rule: A general statement ('easy to remember', 'you can say') takes the we- or you- form of the verb, not the I-form: sehel netzakkarhom.

moments.medi_said: Uh, and then you remember the-- remove the B, right? 'Cause it's to remember. So أتذكرهم.
moments.amal_said: So it's either you or we. 'Cause it's general. ... نتذكرهم.
moments.why: He used the I-form atzakkarhom for the general 'easy to remember them'; Amal said 'it's either you or we, because it's general' and he fixed it to نتذكرهم (chat netzakkarhom).

proposals.proposed_rule: After remind / ask / tell someone, say the action as a verb before the thing: zakkreeni ajib 5ubez (remind me to bring bread), not zakkreeni 5ubez.

moments.medi_said: ذكّرني خبز
moments.amal_said: To bring.
moments.why: For 'Remind me to bring bread' he went from the command straight to the thing (ذكّرني خبز); Amal supplied the missing verb in English ('To bring.', PG-22) and he added a verb (59:14 ذكريني تجيبي). Same shape as GR-27 (laazem needs a verb), but no bucket covers 'remind me + verb', so PROPOSE.

proposals.proposed_rule: Weather takes ONE subject - el-dinya (feminine) or el-jaw (masculine) - never both stacked: el-jaw bared / el-dinya bardeh, not dinya el-jaw.

moments.medi_said: So I say دنيا الجو. ... Okay. دنيا جو.

moments.why: He stacked دنيا + جو twice and Amal said an explicit 'No, no, no. Either دنيا or جو'; no bucket covers a doubled subject.

proposals.proposed_rule: 'Was going to' = kaan (with its person ending) + ra7 + bare verb: kunt ra7 a3malo (I was going to do it).

moments.medi_said: أنا راح أعمله بس الـ زباين، uh, الـ زباين أجو.
moments.amal_said: إنت كنت راح تعمله. ... كنت راح تعمله.
moments.chat: kunet ra7 = I was going to
moments.why: 'I was going to do it but the customers came' needs kunt before ra7; he used plain future راح أعمله; Amal recast كنت راح تعمله twice, typed the rule, and he said 'I don't think we've ever done that before'. B13 (ra7 + bare verb) he got right; the missing kaan for the past is not in any card (B16 is kaan + laazem only).

proposals.proposed_rule: One action takes one verb - do not stack two verbs (a3mal + a5alles) for it: a5adni sa3tain la-a5alles haadi el-taawla

proposals.proposed_rule: A clause after a verb of seeing / knowing / saying needs enno (that): ba3ed ma shufna enno taani mat3am kaan nafs el-ishi.
